name: security-grpc-reflection-exposure-review
intent: gRPC reflection/schema visibility and its incremental confidentiality impact
artifacts: Reflection registration, service descriptors, transport auth/interceptors and an attributable owned service.
trace: Distinguish a discoverable descriptor from callable protected methods or genuinely confidential embedded options/comments. Resolve reflection authentication separately.
experiment: Compare the descriptor visible to an unauthenticated fixture client with intended public API documentation and a restricted method invocation.
disproof: Reflection enabled or a method name exposed is not an authorization bypass; protected RPCs may still be correctly denied.
repair: Restrict truly sensitive schema publication if required and preserve intended tooling; retest descriptors and RPC authority independently.
branch_decisions: Reflection may intentionally publish a public schema; classify actual descriptor content before severity. Authentication interceptors may apply differently to reflection and business RPCs. A reflected method is inventory until the real principal can call it or confidential descriptor content itself is shown.
